biotools.summary: Translates DNA and RNA sequences across six reading frames using standard and alternative NCBI genetic code tables while identifying candidate open reading frames and quantifying codon usage bias. The software computes Relative Synonymous Codon Usage (RSCU), positional GC distributions (GC1, GC2, GC3), and predicted protein physicochemical attributes including molecular weight and isoelectric point. Researchers can interactively evaluate sequences and codon tables through a web application or automate batch analyses via programmatic client libraries that query the remote calculation engine.
